t5_definition_v14.requires: Tracked byte[]/ByteBuffer identity has a FACT edge into at least one of: aget-byte/aget; ByteBuffer.wrap/get*/put*; String([B); or a parse/decode-named invoke that also receives the tracked buffer (dataflow_role).
t5_definition_v14.excludes: InputStream/AccessorySocket read()I or read([B)I *length* move-result (READ_LENGTH); method/class names alone; copy-only without further processing; protocol/message meaning claims.
t5_definition_v14.sees_v13: Transport wrapper read/write; BYTE_ARRAY arg; mis-tagged PRIMITIVE_DECODE from read length; PATH-COMM INBOUND_PRIMITIVE without real byte ops.
t5_definition_v14.cannot_see_v13: Interface consumers (AccessorySocket;->read in BclConnection); Packet.decode* ByteBuffer.getShort/getInt; aget-byte loops; state mutation onto Packet fields after decode.

details: Transport wrappers (BtAccessorySocket.read) only forward to InputStream; no aget/ByteBuffer in retained set.
Real consumers call AccessorySocket;->read via BclConnection.internalread / readPacket — not in v1.3 seed set.
Packet.decode* performs ByteBuffer.wrap + getShort/getInt (FACT byte processing) outside retention.
v1.3 T5 gate required named DECODER nodes; READ_LENGTH was wrongly counted as primitive_decoding but not T5.
